Synthesis: Verified timeline shows r42 release at 10:00 preceded cache_hit drop (92%→51%) at 10:03, error spike (120→810), retry surge (110→2200), dependency CPU=96% at 10:04. Rollback at 10:06 restored metrics.

Hypotheses: (1) Smaller cache in r42 caused increased cache misses → more dependency calls. (2) Retry amplification (110→2200) compounded load on dependency. Combined: cache reduction triggered cascade via dependency overload.

Validation Test: Inspect r41 vs r42 deployment artifacts to verify r42 cache size reduction. If r42 cache < r41 cache, root cause hypothesis confirmed.
